payload.objective: Implement Slice 1 of M2.5: Create the 15 approved modular Blade files under resources/views/r21_seminar/ mounting workspace-layout and report-layout with full <x-ui.*> component reuse and sub-500-line modularity.
payload.explicit_request: Review the implementation TASK_REPORT for task 'M2.5-IMPLEMENT-001' (Slice 1: Master Shells & Modular Blade Partials Structure). Confirm whether Slice 1 is approved and issue TASK_DISPATCH for Slice 2 (M2.5-IMPLEMENT-002: Dedicated Seminar Workspace View & Print Report Feature Test). task_report.summary: Slice 1 completed. 15 modular Blade files created under resources/views/r21_seminar/. All files strictly under 370 lines (< 500 lines constraint). Virtual classroom mounts <x-layouts.workspace-layout> with 5 tabs, 5 modals, stats strip, and client scripts. Print report mounts <x-layouts.report-layout> covering 3 modes. All UI elements reuse <x-ui.*>. Zero syntax errors. 47 tests passed (350 assertions). User.php untouched.

tests.syntax: php -l passed across all 15 Blade files (0 errors)
tests.regression: php artisan test: 47 passed (350 assertions, 0 failures, 0 regressions)

payload.reason: M2.5 Slice 1 is approved to proceed to dedicated verification. The implementation matches the approved 15-file decomposition, with every Blade artifact below the mandatory 500-line ceiling and no unauthorized files reported. The virtual classroom correctly mounts inside <x-layouts.workspace-layout>, the print surface inside <x-layouts.report-layout>, and the reported tables, modals, cards, badges, buttons, inputs, selects, and icons reuse the existing <x-ui.*> component system without duplicate UI infrastructure. The five workspace tabs, five modal workflows, three print modes, M2.4 endpoint contracts, and client-side interaction layer are all reported as represented. Syntax validation and the full regression suite both pass with 47 tests, 350 assertions, and zero failures or regressions. User.php remains untouched and no database changes were introduced. Slice 2 is appropriately isolated as a test-only verification task and must not modify production Blade, controller, route, model, migration, service, or database files; any production defect discovered by verification must be reported rather than silently repaired.

task_dispatch.objective: Create dedicated feature verification for the R21 Seminar workspace and print views, proving master-shell usage, modular partial composition, global component reuse, all five workspace tabs, all five modals, all three print modes, M2.4 backend data bindings, and regression safety.
instructions: Verify the workspace view renders through <x-layouts.workspace-layout> and contains all five expected tabs and the approved modular partial structure.
Verify all five modal workflows are present and use the expected x-ui.modal infrastructure.
Verify the workspace references the six M2.4 Seminar endpoint contracts without introducing or modifying routes.
Verify the print root mounts through <x-layouts.report-layout> with the expected orientation and modular print partial structure.
Verify all three print modes: consolidated, cia_submission, and schedule.
Verify representative data binding for evaluation, schedule, attainment, syllabus, and print contexts using the existing M2.4 backend contract.
Verify the migrated views preserve required statutory Seminar presentation elements and grading/attendance information identified during M2.5 analysis.
Verify the five workspace tabs, five modals, three print modes, master shells, and relevant x-ui.* component usage through deterministic assertions.
Run the dedicated feature test and the complete application regression suite.
Do not repair production implementation while writing tests; report any production defect separately.
constraints: STRICT WHITELIST: only carmel-linx-laravel/tests/Feature/R21SeminarWorkspaceViewTest.php may be created or modified.
DO NOT modify any Blade view.
DO NOT modify models, migrations, services, or database schema.
DO NOT create additional test files.
Do not execute destructive database commands or migrations.
Do not introduce duplicate UI infrastructure.
task_dispatch.expected_report: Report the exact test file and coverage; identify assertions covering workspace-layout, report-layout, five tabs, five modals, three print modes, x-ui.* components, M2.4 endpoint/data bindings, and statutory presentation requirements; provide dedicated test results and full regression results; report any defects or parity gaps; confirm whitelist compliance, User.php safety boundary, absence of database changes, and git status.
stop_conditions: Stop if verification requires modifying any production file.
Stop if an uncovered production defect requires controller, route, model, service, or Blade changes; report it instead.
Do not create files outside the single test-file whitelist.
Do not alter database schema or execute migrations.
